description: Scoped, redacted Copilot CLI-format export of this conversation's Agent Session Insights player, reviewer and repository-building work.
method: Reconstructed from a locally frozen copy of this Copilot CLI session's events.jsonl. Preserves selected visible text, genuine ask_user form answers, timestamps, message identities, tool-call names and authoritative per-request usage. Request IDs are consistently SHA-256 pseudonymized instead of publishing opaque provider call IDs. Original Copilot interaction IDs link requests to typed prompts through matching assistant API-call metadata; form answers are preserved separately and do not invent metered calls. Each exported record retains its original source line.
omitted: Earlier prompt-recovery work and later GitHub Pages discussion outside the selected interval
Cumulative/mirrored accounting records, memory injections and unused native metadata
Encrypted content, opaque provider call IDs and raw model-context snapshots
privacy: Credential redaction is best effort. External shared-session URLs are redacted so this reviewed example does not disclose another conversation. The owner approved this selected conversation for public publication; other logs still require review before sharing. The full original history is not included.
